objective: Evaluate the existing native proposal, context, working-copy and request-binding boundaries against a fixed candidate source tree.

requirements.description: Proposal shape, exact role/request identities and permitted references are checked; model output cannot invent authority.
Captured context remains bound to the current request and source scope.
Revision targets bind exact occurrences and bytes; stale, malformed and mismatched candidates cannot satisfy the edit contract.
Receiving a candidate does not apply it; explicit Apply, cancellation, revocation, Undo and export preserve their existing owner boundaries.
An existing request cannot be relabeled with different input/context, and rejected evidence preserves the existing session state.
